title: Exotic Grilled Saudi Arabian Pork Chops Kebabs
description: A tangy and creamy Saudi Arabian dish featuring pork chops, perfect for a date night, with a low glycemic index.
instructions: In a blender, combine yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Place the pork chops in a large bowl and brush the yogurt mixture evenly over both sides of the pork chops.
Thread the pork chops onto skewers, leaving a small space between each chop.
Grill the kebabs for 5 minutes per side, or until the pork chops reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers promptly.
Reheat leftovers to an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit before serving.
